Carla - Release Eng: deploy-bot paused promo for v1.12.1 — checksum mismatch across mirrors. holding the 15:00 PT change window. https://ci.internal/r/9001 :warning:

deploy-bot: Promo paused release=v1.12.1; reason=checksum_mismatch; key=builds/2026/03/24/v1.12.1.tar.gz; attempts=2; last_err='sha256 expected=0a1b2c3d got=4d3c2b1a'

Ben (infra): quick validate: curl origin and mirror -> origin sha=0a1b2c3d, mirror sha=4d3c2b1a. mirror is eventual CDN and shows stale object. Options: pin to last_good (tag release/v1.12.1-lastgood), wait unknown time, or reupload.

Alice M.: we have release notes + customer comms scheduled. I'm inclined to pin and proceed with smoke tests. We'll annotate notes and open an infra ticket.

Carla - Release Eng: agree. deploy-bot suggestion=pin to release/v1.12.1-lastgood. Approve to proceed?

deploy-bot: suggested_action=pin; suggested_tag=release/v1.12.1-lastgood; to_confirm=@Carla - run `deploy-bot confirm-pin release/v1.12.1-lastgood`

Carla - Release Eng: confirming pin, conditional on infra creating ticket and reupload attempt. Ben please create INC-2050.

Ben (infra): ticket INC-2050 created https://tracker/internal/INC-2050 assigned to infra-storage. Starting promote from lastgood and kicking off reupload to CDN. cictl promote -> job promote-2468 started.

ci-bot: job promote-2468 started. logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/promote-2468

Emma QA: I'll run minimal e2e on canary after promote (approx 7m) and report status.

ci-bot: job promote-2468 completed -> SUCCESS. promoted_artifact=release/v1.12.1-lastgood.tar.gz

deploy-bot: Promotion completed for v1.12.1; artifact=release/v1.12.1-lastgood.tar.gz; promoted_by=promote-2468; time=2026-03-24T15:09:59Z :white_check_mark:

Emma QA: canary smoke all green. signing off. :rocket:

Carla - Release Eng: added short note to release draft: "artifact pinned to last good build due to CDN mirror checksum inconsistency; infra is reconciling (INC-2050)." Scheduling final slack announcement at 16:00 PT.

Alice M.: thanks all. Closing thread. Follow-ups: infra to finish CDN reconciliation and add automation card to detect multi-replica checksum drift. :thumbsup:
